text: Pity is often a reflection of our own evils in the ills of others. It is a delicate foresight of the troubles into which we may fall. We help others that on like occasions we may be helped ourselves.
author: Francois de La Rochefoucauld
reference: Reflections; or Sentences and Moral Maxims
translation: J. W. Willis Bund and J. Hain Friswell, 1871
